description: Files permitted to read process.env directly instead of going through src/env.ts's typed, validated config boundary. AGENTS.md: 'No new process.env outside src/env.ts.' Every entry must be reviewed, not assumed safe by convention.

entries.reason: The typed/validated env boundary itself — this is the one file allowed to read raw process.env, by definition.

Test-only database override (TEST_DATABASE_URL) for the throwaway Docker Postgres harness. Never touches production: assertLocalTestDb() refuses any non-localhost/non-test-db host and rejects anything matching a Supabase-shaped URL before this value is ever used.

The Task 01 sandbox workspace's own typed env boundary — same role as src/env.ts, scoped to apps/experiment-sandbox. Reads a curated allowlist of OS/shell passthrough variables (Path, TEMP, HOME, CI, TERM, etc. — no secrets) for spawning a controlled child process, plus npm_execpath, which is itself validated with isLocalPath() before use.
